messages:
sam: Heads up — quota telemetry for service-account tokens looks artificially low in the dashboard. noticed it across a few customers this morning.
olga: I saw that too. initial guess: sampling is keyed by api_key hash but our edge proxies rewrite/rotate the header so the same logical SA shows up as many ephemeral keys -> sampler treats them as different and under-samples the effective identity.
vikram: Can you paste an example request trace? is effective_identity being propagated (x-effective-identity / trace_id)?
olga: here's a quick snippet from the trace log:
```
edge-proxy: recv auth=sha256:abc123 -> forwarded as bearer token t=proxy-xyz
redwood-auth: lookup returned service_account:sa-42 effective_id=sa-42
```
But the sampling key we use is `auth.key_hash` which is different for each forwarded token.
jess: If we change sampler key we need to be careful about PII/leakage. effective_id is fine but only present after auth lookup (extra latency).
maria: proposal: two-tier sampling. keep current fast sampler for raw keys (no extra lookup) but add a low-rate deterministic sample for effective_identity when available. that would give visibility into long-tail SAs without increasing qps on auth lookup.
vikram: sounds reasonable. config sketch:
```
auth.sampling:
  fast_rate: 0.01          # legacy key-hash sampler
  identity:
    enabled: true
    deterministic_rate: 0.001
    key: effective_identity || api_key_id
```
sam: +1. Also need to handle proxy-forged headers: only use effective_identity if verified by auth service (signed header or token introspection).
olga: agree. i'll add a check: `auth_verified == true` before emitting identity-based sample.
jess: will this affect quota attribution? we should ensure sampled identity maps to same billing/project. otherwise dashboards will show mismatches.
maria: plan: when identity-sample fires include payload `billing_project`, `tenant_id`, `trace_id` so attribution later joins are reliable. minimal fields only.
vikram: action items: (1) olga will run a one-off query to estimate coverage and false positives by sampling identity over 24h; (2) i will add feature-flag `auth.sampling.v2` behind canary; (3) maria will update console widgets to show sampled vs fast-sampled counts and a note about sampling bias.
sam: timeline? can we do a small canary next week?
olga: i'll run the query today and post numbers by EOD. if numbers look ok i'll open a PR for the auth service change.
maria: i'll draft a UI stub for the telemetry panel — need copy for the hover tooltip explaining deterministic sampling.
authbot: Deploy check scheduled: canary window must be >= 2 hours, include dashboards alert `telemetry.sampling.delta > 20%`.
sam: sweet. thanks all :thumbsup:
